messages.subject: widgets next to each-other?
parts:
Suppose this is my app:

## app.R ##
library(shiny)
library(shinydashboard)

ui <- dashboardPage(
  dashboardHeader(),
  dashboardSidebar(),
  dashboardBody(
    fluidRow(
      box(
        title = "Big Box", width = 10, solidHeader = TRUE, status = "primary",
        selectInput("Dropdown1", "Dropdown 1:",
                    c("0.01" = 0.01,
                      "0.05" = 0.05,
                      "0.1" = 0.1), 
                    selected = 0.05), 
        
        selectInput("Dropdown2", "Dropdown 2:",
                    c("0.9" = 0.9,
                      "0.8" = 0.8,
                      "0.7" = 0.7), 
                    selected = 0.8)
      ),
      
      box(
        title = "Small Box", width = 2, solidHeader = TRUE, status = "warning",
        "Box content"
      )
    )
  )
)

server <- function(input, output) { }

shinyApp(ui, server)

Is it possible to position the 2 `selectInput` widgets next to each-other?

Thanks!

parts: I'm not sure if this is the "best" way, but you can put the two selectInputs inside of a flowLayout():

box(
        title = "Big Box", width = 10, solidHeader = TRUE, status = "primary",
